notes.yield_placement: Under the arrow in crops 01, 03 and 05. Crop 04 puts endpoint yields as a text block beside the final product (process_route), and crop 08 puts an inset yield table under product 1.
notes.conditions_split: Reagents above with solvent and temperature below in crop 01 (panel b), crop 03, crop 04 and crop 06. Crops 05 and 08 put all conditions above the arrow.
notes.abbreviate_groups: Boc, CF3, Me and NO2 are written as labels in at least two reaction-scheme crops: Boc, CF3 and Me in crops 01, 02 and 03; NO2 in crops 04, 05 and 08; OCF3 in crops 05 and 08. OTBS is written in crop 05 only, so it is removed. SO2Me is written as text in crops 01, 02, 03 and 07 but has no entry in the abbreviation table, so the card cannot name it.
notes.yield_format: Spread: crop 01 writes '{value} % yield' (space before the percent sign); crop 03 writes 'A%: ~40 %' and 'IY: 52 %' (label and space); crop 08 writes 'PMBz: 40%' (label). Crops 02, 04, 05 and 08 write '{value}%' without a space, so that form is kept.
notes.arrow_length_over_bond_length: Spread: crop 03 measures 622 / 85 = 7.3 and crop 05 measures 720 / 80 = 9.0 (mean 8.2). The card keeps 8.0 between them.
notes.measurements: Bond and cap height are measured on crops 03 and 05 only: bond / cap 2.1 (crop 03) and 1.9 (crop 05). Line width / bond: 0.082 (crop 03) and 0.088 (crop 05). Other crops are low-resolution web images where only line width was read.
notes.substrate_colors: Null: crop 02 (graphical abstract) and crop 07 (retrosynthesis) colour building blocks, but no reaction-scheme crop does, so the two-crop rule for top-level conventions is not met.
notes.new_bond_color: Null: no reaction-scheme crop colours formed bonds. Crop 02 colours whole building blocks, not new bonds.
notes.compound_label_italic_suffix: Null, not false: an italic scale after the bold number (5 (100mg)) appears in crop 03 only. Crop 04 writes its scales as plain-text route headers.
notes.show_plus_sign: False: no plus sign between co-reactants in crops 01 (panel b), 03, 04, 05, 06 and 08. Crop 07 (a retrosynthesis) puts plus signs between fragments; it is not a reaction scheme.
notes.substrate_layout: Reagents are written over the arrow; no two-partner layout seen twice.

process_route.notes: Step labels are numbered only in panel a of crop 01, so the value is null. Crop 02 gives step counts, not numbers; crop 04 numbers its reagent lines (1. 2.) inside one arrow; crop 06 numbers reagents (1) 2)) and has no step labels. The step count is shown in crop 02 only, and the scale in crop 04 only. Yield format: '{value}% yield' follows crops 01 and 02 (with or without a space before the percent sign). Crop 04 writes 'Yield {value}% Purity {purity}%' and is the only crop with purity. Crop 06 has no yield text. Crops 01 and 06 number telescoped intermediates in bold; crop 04 captions its bracket 'not isolated'.
